title: Lanes
description: Hairline lanes stream in as a tight ribbon, peel off one by one to draw the outline of the type, and the word fills solid. It leaves the same way in reverse: the fill melts to outline and every line runs out along its own lane.

title: Pipework
description: Shaded tubes arrive packed side by side like a cable harness, jog through right-angle bends and plumb themselves into the outline of the type, which stays as tube letters. On exit the tubes unplug and bend away down their lanes.

title: Twist
description: Pairs the departing strands of one word with the arriving strands of the next, gathers them into a tight cable and winds them around the cable axis in a helix before they fan back out. Tune it with turns and handed.

title: FLOW > BENDS (demo camera)
description: Two modules chained: lanes forms FLOW on a tilted plane at the left, its lines are carried by a twist and plumbed into BENDS (pipework) on a differently angled plane at the upper right. Fixed demo camera.

title: FLOW > BENDS (follow camera)
description: Two modules chained: lanes forms FLOW on a tilted plane at the left, its lines are carried by a twist and plumbed into BENDS (pipework) on a differently angled plane at the upper right. A FlowPath camera follows the strands and rests on each formed word.

title: SIGNAL > BENDS > FLOW (demo camera)
description: Three modules, two transitions, each word on its own plane: lanes SIGNAL (left, tilted) -> right-handed twist -> pipework BENDS (upper right) -> left-handed three-turn twist -> lanes FLOW (lower centre, front-facing). Fixed demo camera.

title: SIGNAL > BENDS > FLOW (follow camera)
description: Three modules, two transitions, each word on its own plane: lanes SIGNAL (left, tilted) -> right-handed twist -> pipework BENDS (upper right) -> left-handed three-turn twist -> lanes FLOW (lower centre, front-facing). A FlowPath camera follows the strands and rests on each formed word.
